text:
Ice Energy
A key resource for unleashing Special Attacks and Expertise Skills. Starts with a maximum of 50 points, regenerating 2 points per second.

Basic Attack: Raincall Surge
Unleashes up to four consecutive water-based attacks, each dealing Magic Damage.

Tips: When Ice Energy is low, this skill allows you to deal DMG flexibly as needed.

Deals Attack DMG equal to 100% ATK to all the enemies, which scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack.
Restores 10 Courage immediately upon use.

Grants a Nature Shield to the caster and up to 10 nearby allies.

Tips: Great for high-pressure moments, helping stabilize the party. Pairs well with Smite Spec Talents for healing allies.

Enters a defensive stance, gaining immunity to all DMG. If hit while in this stance, counterattacks with a slash and leaps backward. Recast to dash forward and slash, dealing Attack Damage. If the attack hits a target, gains max Thunder Sigils.

Tips: Release under intense battles or when confident in timing to gain Thunder Sigil more efficiently.

Quickly slashes horizontally with a scythe condensed from lightning, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">400%</style> ATK to the enemy, which scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Thundercut</style>.

Basic Attack: Thunderclap Arcane
Performs up to three consecutive thunder-infused strikes, each dealing Thunder Element damage.
Plunge Attack:·Thunderfall from the Heavens
Charges lightning energy into the gauntlet mid-air, then dives down to impact the ground, dealing Thunder Element damageon landing.
Heavy Strike: Thunder Onslaught
Gathers energy to unleash a powerful cannon blast. During the charge, consumes heat gauge to continuously stack Thunder Onslaught, which increases DMG and range. Releasing the skill or completing the charge unleashes a wide fan-shaped Lightning area damage.
Thunderclap
Increases the next Thunder Onslaught's DMG and AoE range, stacking up to 3 times.

Pro Tips: When monsters are close, hold down Basic Attack to more efficiently knock them back.

Summons a powerful combat Companion to provide assistance in battle.

Summon Wild Wolf: The summoned Wild Wolf pounces on the current target, dealing Attack DMG to the target and nearby enemies, then joins the battle for 20s before disappearing.

Summon Falcon: The summoned Falcon dives in a straight line, dealing Attack DMG to all enemies in its path before disappearing.

Tips: Boosts the number of active Companions during the battle. Casting is recommended when all buffs are prepared to ensure maximum efficiency.
Fires a giant arrow at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">1000%</style> ATK.

Increases your MATK for a period of time and amplifies the next skill you cast.

Special Attack: Your next 2 Special Attacks do not consume Performance Passion.
Fivefold Crescendo: Doubles the healing instances.
Heroic Melody: Halves the time needed to trigger Fierce Strike.
Harmonic Anthem: Doubles the DMG dealt.
Passion Burst: Allows for direct cast in its strongest form, no chanting required.

Tips: Evaluate the battle environment and your combat style, then apply the appropriate enhancement at the optimal moment.

Consumes 2 Holy Sigils. Performs a fiery blade strike at all nearby enemies, dealing Attack DMG.

Tips: Powerful offensive skill. Use when survivability is not an issue.

Unleashes formidable energy to weaken nearby <style="accent-gn">enemies</style>, reducing their <style="accent-gn">movement speed</style>. monsters below <style="accent-gn">15%</style> HP will instantly <style="accent-gn">disperse</style>.
Throws multiple daggers forward, dealing DMG to <style="accent-gn">enemies</style> and inflicting <linktext=1023><style="ItemQuality_5">Vulnerable</style></linktext>.

Unleashes Sigil: Blazing Surge, dealing minor area damage and creating Blazing Traps in the area. These traps explode on contact with enemies or after a period of time, dealing DMG to surrounding enemies.
Sigil: Summon at least 2 Blazing Traps, with a chance to summon up to 5.

Summons Boss: Muku King to channel Forest Energy, healing up to 10 allies over time and dispelling debuffs.
Upon the skill cast, your healing received is increased for a period.

<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Brigand Guard Captain to grant Earth Shield, recovering a percentage of lost HP when you are attacked, up to <style="accent-gn">9</style> times. During this, your <style="accent-gn">Endurance</style> is increased.

Summons Elite: Lizardman Mage to conjure the Water of Silence at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG and inflicting Slow.
Upon the skill cast, your Ice Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Blackfire Foxen to pounce on, bite, and then swipe its tail at the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, your Mastery is increased for a period of time.

Summons Boss: Void Watcher, dealing Magic DMG and occupying an area for a period of time.
You and your teammates within the area gain increased ATK, Attack SPD, and Casting SPD. The effect on yourself is multiplied by 2.5.
(Does not stack; only one of the same effect may be active.)
While running continuously, you can break the speed limit and gain a speed boost.
Increase speed after release. The speed of skill CD increases while moving.
A leap combining strength and beauty, leaving a beautiful arc!

Summons one of four playing cards. What surprise awaits?

Lucky Heart: Restores 1 charge of Teleport Trick.
Lucky Spade: Your next Teleport Trick will cover more distance.
Lucky Diamond: Increases the cooldown recovery speed of Teleport Trick for a period of time.
Lucky Club: Increases Movement SPD for a period of time.
The dragon's form is as endless as the clouds it commands. After casting, it can transform into different parts.
Detonate the sound wave! Upon casting, instantly resets Musical Glide's CD. For a short time afterwards, successive casts of Musical Glide won't trigger CD.
Summon lightning around you, paralyzing hit players

Fires a Super Electro Cannon forward, dealing moderate damage.
Recharges once every 10s, up to 3 charges.
"That spark dancing on your fingertips... it's the light I'll follow forever!"

The next time damage is taken, deals 100 damage to the attacker.
The Reflection Shield effect is only visible to the user.
